mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit growth expectations, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) growth rates below -0.5% signals a broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST growth rates are below -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), high inflation (CPIAUCSL yoy growth > 6.0%) signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive rate hikes that suppress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL growth > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust household demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month rolling average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% for at least 3 months indicates an ongoing monetary easing cycle, lowering discount rates and supporting equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% for 3+ months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth above 0.5% and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 0.2 percentage points signals a robust labor market, enhancing consumer spending and corporate profit growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp.
